answer: Make each identity costly and slow to grow, like tending an orchard: an agent must lock a bond and complete verifiable work over weeks before earning full trading rights. Spawning a thousand sybils then means funding a thousand bonds and doing a thousand jobs. Add fingerprinting: every agent leaves a distinct pigment in how it prices and settles, so copies sharing one pattern stand out and can be quarantined. And let cheap talk drift away like a zephyr: only settled transactions, slashed when dishonest, move reputation. Costly identity plus slow reputation makes sybil attacks unprofitable.
